properties.title: Meeting Pebble
properties.text: Narrator: The little dinosaur smiled with bright golden eyes.

properties.title: Friendly Waving
properties.text: Narrator: The tiny dinosaur copied Sara's wave.

properties.title: A Careful Beginning
properties.text:
Narrator: Sara tucked a shiny crystal she found beside the window into her pocket.
Narrator: Outside, the little dinosaur waited patiently.

outcomes.label: Jump fallen logs
outcomes.description: Sara discovers an ancient tune carried by the wind.

outcomes.label: Follow glowing mushrooms
outcomes.description: A hidden path leads beneath sparkling ferns.

properties.title: Song Of The Dinosaurs
properties.text: Narrator: Strange birds and tiny dinosaurs sang together.

properties.title: Secret Tunnel
properties.text:
Narrator: The tunnel opened into a cave filled with glittering crystals.
Narrator: Something enormous had once slept here.

properties.title: New Friends
properties.text:
Narrator: Dozens of tiny dinosaurs happily ran beside Sara.
Tiny Dinosaurs: Come to the party!

properties.title: Dinosaur Party Valley
properties.text:
Narrator: Hundreds of friendly dinosaurs danced beneath thousands of twinkling stars.
Narrator: Fireflies floated between towering long-necked dinosaurs.
Grandma Brontosaurus: Welcome, Sara.
Grandma Brontosaurus: We've been hoping you'd come.

properties.title: The Secret Crystal Cave
properties.text:
Narrator: Crystals reflected tiny stars across the walls.
Narrator: A feather made of pure starlight drifted gently into Sara's hands.

properties.title: Dinosaur Dancing
properties.text:
Narrator: Sara laughed as every dinosaur stomped together.
Tiny Dinosaurs: ROAR! ROAR! ROAR!

properties.title: Ancient Wisdom
properties.text: Grandma Brontosaurus: Every child belongs to more than one world.

properties.title: The Twinkling Sky
properties.text:
Narrator: One bright star floated down into Sara's hands.
Narrator: It shimmered like a tiny silver scale.

properties.title: The Stars Awaken
properties.text:
Narrator: Every dinosaur lifted its head and sang.
Narrator: The stars slowly began moving across the sky.
Narrator: They formed a glowing bridge of light.

properties.title: Learning The Ancient Song
properties.text:
Narrator: Grandma Brontosaurus taught Sara the oldest dinosaur song.
Narrator: The final note echoed into the heavens.

outcomes.label: Hop across the Star Bridge
outcomes.description: Every step makes the sky sparkle.

properties.title: Sky Meadow
properties.text: Narrator: Floating islands drifted among sparkling clouds.

properties.title: The Star Bridge
properties.text:
Narrator: Every footstep became a tiny constellation.
Narrator: The sky glittered brighter with each laugh.

properties.title: Stella
properties.text: Narrator: An enormous dragon made of stars smiled warmly.

properties.title: Home Beneath The Morning Sky
properties.text: Narrator: The stars slowly faded as Pebble walked Sara back through the quiet forest.

properties.title: Honorary Dinosaur
properties.text:
Narrator: Grandma Brontosaurus gently placed a necklace of polished fossils around Sara's neck.
Grandma Brontosaurus: From this day forward, you are an Honorary Dinosaur.
Tiny Dinosaurs: Hooray!

properties.title: Dinosaur Magic
properties.text:
Narrator: Stella breathed a swirl of sparkling starlight around Sara.
Narrator: Tiny glowing scales shimmered across her arms before fading into magical patterns.

properties.title: The Stars Decide
properties.condition: has_item('crystal_fossil') and has_item('comet_feather') and has_item('star_scale') and has_knowledge('ancient_roar')

properties.title: The Morning Surprise
properties.text:
Narrator: Sara woke in her own bed just as the first birds began to sing.
Narrator: At first she wondered if the whole adventure had been a dream.
Narrator: Then she noticed tiny dinosaur footprints outside her bedroom window.

properties.title: Dinosaur Family
properties.text:
Narrator: Every full moon, Sara returned to the valley for music, dancing, and stories.
Narrator: She became famous among the little dinosaurs for telling wonderful human tales.

properties.title: Magical Dinosaur Powers
properties.text:
Narrator: Stella smiled and touched Sara with another beam of starlight.
Narrator: Sara discovered she could...
Narrator: ...jump higher than any dinosaur...
Narrator: ...call tiny friendly dinosaurs with a cheerful whistle...
Narrator: ...make flowers bloom wherever she walked...
Narrator: ...and leave sparkling footprints that glowed beneath the stars.

properties.title: The Hidden Constellation
properties.text:
Narrator: The Crystal Fossil floated upward.
Narrator: The Comet Feather began to spin.
Narrator: The Star Scale shone brighter than the moon.
Narrator: Together they formed a brand-new constellation across the heavens.

properties.title: Secret Visitor
properties.text:
Narrator: That evening Sara heard a gentle knock on her window.
Narrator: Pebble was waiting outside with a basket of glowing prehistoric berries.

properties.title: The Great Story Festival
properties.text:
Narrator: Every year Sara returned for the Great Story Festival.
Narrator: Dinosaurs came from forests, mountains, deserts, and hidden valleys just to hear her adventures.
Tiny Dinosaurs: Tell us another!

properties.title: Keeper Of Dinosaur Magic
properties.text:
Narrator: Sara became the protector of every magical dinosaur path hidden around the world.
Narrator: Lost baby dinosaurs always found their way home with her help.

properties.title: Star Dinosaur
properties.text:
Narrator: Stella lifted Sara gently into the night sky.
Narrator: Sparkling constellations swirled around her like ribbons.
Narrator: A cloak of shimmering stars wrapped around Sara's shoulders.
Narrator: Soft glowing dinosaur markings appeared wherever the starlight touched her.

properties.title: The End (Friends Forever)
properties.text:
Narrator: Sometimes the best adventures begin with a tiny set of mysterious footprints.
Narrator: Sara and Pebble stayed best friends forever.
Narrator: THE END.

properties.title: The End (Honorary Dinosaur)
properties.text:
Narrator: Sara discovered that family isn't about looking the same.
Narrator: It's about laughing, helping, and celebrating together.
Narrator: THE END.

properties.title: The End (Dinosaur Magic)
properties.text:
Narrator: Wherever Sara walked, flowers bloomed, little dinosaurs smiled, and courage grew.
Narrator: She never forgot the magical night that changed her forever.
Narrator: THE END.

properties.title: The End (Star Dinosaur)
properties.text:
Narrator: Whenever children looked up at a sky full of twinkling stars, they sometimes imagined they could see a smiling girl racing joyfully beside friendly dinosaurs.
Narrator: And perhaps... they really did.
Narrator: THE END.

properties.title: Footprints In The Garden
properties.text:
Narrator: Sara looked out her bedroom window and saw tiny glowing footprints crossing the garden.
Narrator: They were much too big for a bird and much too small for a horse.
